# Bhartiya Nikoo Homes 8

> Studio to 4 BHK homes and a limited courtyard villa release by Bhartiya Urban at Bellahalli, off Thanisandra Main Road, North Bengaluru.

Bhartiya Nikoo Homes 8 (Bhartiya Garden Enclave) is an approximately 11.35-acre development of about 1,010 homes across six towers, launched on 17 June 2026, with a 40,000+ sq ft clubhouse (the Black Swan Club), about 75% open space and a car-free Central Spine. It is on a separate parcel about five to seven minutes from the Bhartiya City township — not inside it. Indicative launch prices run from about Rs 67 lakh (studio) to about Rs 2.94 crore (4 BHK + staff). Karnataka RERA: Phase 1 PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/070526/008628, Phase 2 PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/070526/008629; RERA-filed completion December 2030.

This website is operated by Real Revenue, an authorised channel partner. It is not the official website of Bhartiya Urban. Prices are indicative and revised release to release.

## Project Information

- [Home](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/): Nikoo Homes 8 by Bhartiya Urban at Bellahalli, Thanisandra Main Road. Studio to 4 BHK from ₹67 lakh and courtyard villas. Price, floor plan, amenities, RERA.
- [About Nikoo Homes 8](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/about-nikoo-homes-8): Bhartiya Nikoo Homes 8, also called Bhartiya Garden Enclave: how it differs from Nikoo Homes 1 to 5, what works, what to weigh and who it suits. By Real Revenue.
- [Configurations](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/configurations): All Nikoo Homes 8 configurations with carpet and saleable area, tower placement and indicative price: studio, 1 to 4 BHK, the duplex loft and courtyard villas.
- [Price](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/price): Nikoo Homes 8 price list 2026: studio ₹67 lakh to 4 BHK ₹2.94 crore at about ₹12,000 per sq ft, villas from ₹5.98 crore. Cost sheet, charges, EOI and payment plan.
- [Floor Plan](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/floor-plan): Nikoo Homes 8 floor plan for all nine types, studio (501 sq ft) to 4 BHK + staff (2,506 sq ft), plus courtyard villas: rooms, decks, carpet and saleable areas, brochure PDF.
- [Master Plan](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/master-plan): Nikoo Homes 8 master plan: six towers in two offset blocks, a car-free Central Spine, the Black Swan Club, 22 landscape zones and 75% open ground on 11.35 acres.
- [Amenities](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/amenities): Nikoo Homes 8 amenities: 40,000 sq ft Black Swan Club with rooftop pool, gym, spa and co-working, four pools, sports courts, tracks and themed gardens on a car-free spine.

## Location

- [Location](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/location): Nikoo Homes 8 location: Bellahalli, off Thanisandra Main Road, 5.6 km from Manyata Tech Park, 5–7 min from Bhartiya City, 25 min from the airport. Metro, schools, hospitals.
- [Bhartiya City](https://bhartiyanikoohomes8.com/bhartiya-city): Bhartiya City Nikoo Homes guide: the 125-acre township near Hebbal, Nikoo Homes 1 to 5, RERA numbers by phase, resale vs new launch, and Nikoo Homes 8 at Bellahalli.
